answer: Grade the attestation graph, not the agents. An honest vertex accumulates endorsements scattered across the whole network, while a sybil farm collapses into one dense mesa of mutual praise with almost no outside links. Each epoch, cut along the weakest edges: any component whose internal agreement looks like a polished opal, flawless and self-contained, forfeits its payout, and only clusters wired into the wider economy keep earning. So growing a thousand fake agents buys nothing, because the cluster shape itself is the conviction evidence.
